description.narrative: (Tunisia): .USAID/Tunisia's JOBS activity partners with Tunisian businesses to tackle operational, financial, and management constraints including; access to new markets, increase revenues, and generate employment opportunities. In partnership with the private sector and local organizations, the activity also develops workforce skills to better match the requirements of the private sector, with training and job placement services for young graduates and job-seekers. Lastly, the activity is providing e-service and digital solutions to optimize regulations, procedures, and authorizations that would reduce the time and cost of services for businesses, facilitate investment and trade, and promote private sector-led innovation...This implementing mechanism contributes $1,200,000 ($300,000 ESF and $900,000 DA) to the Women Leadership earmark..

Objectives for Tunisia: PROJECT OBJECTIVES: Create jobs by increasing the competitiveness of Tunisian SMEs; Improve the match between skills demanded by the labor market and the training provided by education and vocational institutions; Improve Tunisia’s business enabling environment; Communicate the initiatives and impacts of JOBS as well as the importance of market-led growth, with a particular focus on youth.
